results.corrected_title: Google DeepMind is building a robotics hardware lab in the Boston area, sited in Watertown
results.corrected_summary: Aaron Saunders, Google DeepMind's robotics hardware chief and former Boston Dynamics CTO, announced in a LinkedIn recruiting post around 12 October 2026 that DeepMind is building a new hardware lab in the 'Cambridge area'. On 15 October the Boston Globe reported, citing a City of Watertown permit, that Google has leased 35,000 sq ft of the 50,000 sq ft Arsenal on the Charles building (200 Talcott Ave., Watertown). Construction is due to finish in 2027, and DeepMind is hiring machinists, engineers and researchers. Google declined to comment.
key_facts: Lab announced by Aaron Saunders in a LinkedIn recruiting post (AI Insider, 13 Oct 2026, says it was posted on Monday, i.e. 12 Oct)
Boston Globe (15 Oct): 35,000 sq ft lease in the 50,000 sq ft Arsenal on the Charles building, 200 Talcott Ave., Watertown, owned by Alexandria Real Estate Equities
Saunders joined DeepMind in 2025 after 22 years at Boston Dynamics, where he was CTO
Construction is due to finish in 2027; DeepMind is hiring machinists, engineers and researchers
Google declined to comment to the Globe
results.issues: Sources disagree on the location. Saunders's post and a DeepMind job ad say 'Cambridge area' or Cambridge, MA, while the Globe puts the lab in Watertown based on a city permit. The lease was signed 'earlier this summer' according to the Globe. An earlier X post suggests Saunders had already been recruiting for a Boston-area 'machine shop'. So the hardware team is not entirely new, but the lab announcement and the details about the site are from inside the window. The claim that DeepMind will compete directly with Tesla and Figure is speculation. Saunders's title varies between sources.

results.corrected_title: Zealand Pharma signs deal worth up to nearly $1.2bn with Generate Biomedicines for AI-designed obesity proteins
results.corrected_summary: On 13 October 2026, Danish Zealand Pharma and Generate Biomedicines (backed by Flagship Pioneering) agreed a collaboration and licence deal to develop multispecific protein drugs for obesity and other metabolic diseases, designed with Generate's generative AI platform. Generate gets $30m upfront and up to $35m in early preclinical milestones, with total milestones of up to nearly $1.2bn plus tiered royalties. The deal covers two initial programmes, and Zealand has an option to add a third. Generate leads research up to candidate selection; Zealand handles clinical development, regulatory work and worldwide commercialisation.
key_facts: Announced 13 Oct 2026 (GlobeNewswire release; Reuters story the same day)
$30m upfront; up to $35m in early preclinical milestones; up to nearly $1.2bn in total milestones plus tiered royalties
Two initial programmes, with a Zealand option to add a third
Generate leads research to candidate selection; Zealand takes clinical development and global commercialisation
Generate shares rose about 5% in extended trading (Reuters)
results.issues: No material errors. The 'option on a third programme' comes from search summaries of the press release; Fierce and Reuters, both opened, do not mention it. Fierce's article is dated 14 Oct; the announcement itself was 13 Oct. Total value is described as 'up to nearly $1.2bn' in milestones, not a firm $1.2bn.

results.corrected_title: Robot foundation models go commercial: Physical Intelligence opens Pi API beta, Neura Robotics launches Neuron AI
results.corrected_summary: On 13 October 2026, Physical Intelligence opened a beta of its Pi API, a hosted service where developers upload robot data, fine-tune Pi's robot foundation models on Pi-managed compute and run cloud-hosted inference on their own robots. Access is through a waitlist. On 14 October, Germany's Neura Robotics launched Neuron AI, a multimodal foundation model for physical AI. It combines 3D vision, touch, audio, robot state and language with memory, was trained across five Neura robot embodiments, and draws on data partners including Schaeffler and Bosch.
key_facts: Physical Intelligence announced 'Frontier Models for Every Robot' / Pi API beta on 13 Oct 2026
Pi API: upload data, fine-tune, hosted cloud inference; waitlist access; pricing not published
Early Pi API partners reportedly include Chef Robotics, CloudChef, AgRobotics, Actor and Almond
Neura Robotics' Neuron AI was announced 14 Oct 2026 and uses a Perception-Language-Action architecture with memory
Neuron AI was trained across five Neura robot embodiments; data partners include Schaeffler and Bosch; it will be shown at Nvidia GTC Berlin, 20-22 Oct
results.issues: This item combines two separate announcements from 13 and 14 Oct. Which models the Pi API offers varies across secondary sources. The partner list comes from secondary sources, not the Pi page opened. Neuron AI pricing and general availability were not disclosed.
